description: ui_context.ex — confirm is listed in @one_arity_fields but its type signature is (String.t(), keyword() -> boolean()), a 2-arity function. The stub generates a 1-arity function, so ctx.confirm.('msg', title: 'X') would fail at runtime. Move to @two_arity_fields.
title: Move confirm from @one_arity_fields to @two_arity_fields in UIContext
